title_en: Beautiful Places in China (17/20): Zhangye Danxia, a Rainbow Across the Land
note_en: 之所以…是由于… gives the cause of a fact that has already been stated: 岩石之所以呈现出七彩颜色，是由于含有不同的… "the reason the rocks show a rainbow of colors is that they contain different minerals." English usually puts "because" first or in the middle, but this pattern names the result first and saves the cause for the end, which sounds formal and explanatory. Xiao Zhou uses it again at the end: 这些山之所以显得如此有生命力，是由于每一层岩石里都藏着数百万年的记忆.
